title: SAPT 87HYC corn (Makisig 87): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: SAPT 87HYC corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: SAPT 87HYC corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety for Mindanao. 108 to 111 days to harvest, 7.1 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: SAPT 87HYC corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Makisig 87. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2025 as NSIC 2025 Cn 343. Southside Agro Trading bred it. It takes 108 to 111 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7.08 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 108 to 111 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 7.08 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

SAPT 87HYC corn takes 108 to 111 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 5.9 days longer than the average of the 215 yellow hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 103.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.08 t/ha matches the average of its group, 7.17. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 16.65 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 75.1 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
Where and when to plant SAPT 87HYC corn

It is recommended for Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Makisig 87 the same as SAPT 87HYC?
items.a: Yes. Makisig 87 is another name for SAPT 87HYC, registered as NSIC 2025 Cn 343. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 108 to 111 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 7.08 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of SAPT 87HYC?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
